explanation: Accumulate source digits with multiply-add in the source base, then divide repeatedly by the destination base to obtain digits from least to most significant. Reverse them, retaining a minus sign only for nonzero values. BigInt prevents rounding or overflow.
timeComplexity: O(d²+e²) bit operations using ordinary arithmetic, for d input and e output digits
spaceComplexity: O(d+e) bits/digits for the value and output
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
